# Boots Never Collected

*A pair of boots left at Simkin's bench months ago was never collected, the soles white with chalk and pocked with stings. He wants to know where they walked, and whether Gytha knows whose they are.*

## Objectives

1. Reach the chalk bank in [The Thyme Banks](../maps/thyme_banks.md)
2. Defeat 30 [Wild Bee](../monsters/wild_bee.md) in [The Thyme Banks](../maps/thyme_banks.md)
3. Talk to [Gytha](../npcs/gytha.md)
